Today was my first time having a dental check-up at this clinic (I usually go to a clinic near my home). I met a female dentist who used to be both a professor and the deputy dean of the Faculty of Dentistry at Khon Kaen University. She was incredibly kind and attentive to her patients. I have a problem with tartar buildup, requiring frequent scaling. A dentist at my local clinic had mentioned this, but they didn't explain the reason.
During my visit today, the dentist explained the cause clearly. Because I have overlapping teeth, brushing alone isn't enough to clean thoroughly. She recommended using a multi-purpose flosser and taught me the correct flossing technique. I learned that using regular plastic floss isn't completely removing tartar. I was very impressed and will definitely return.

P.S.
